title: Affordance-Based Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Pedipulation
summary: The object manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots is an open research challenge. While previous studies have focused on low-level policy learning, task execution still relies on expert-designed high-level trajectories. Autonomous selection of both an affordable interaction point on the target object and an affordable robot base pose removes the need for pre-designed trajectories. This study proposes a three-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes pose affordances to guide the navigation policy, while the navigation policy drives the locomotion policy. In addition, the pedipulation policy is guided by interaction-point affordances, enabling object-centric pose alignment of the quadruped robot and effective end-effector manipulation planning. We train the proposed framework in the IsaacSim ecosystem and evaluate it in both simulation and real-world settings. We investigate the effectiveness of pose affordance across multiple scenarios in simulation while various object interaction tasks are validated on real-world setting forming an object-interaction dataset. The results show that the proposed framework can autonomously identify candidate poses based on their affordance and successfully execute object manipulation tasks in the real world without human guidance.
tldr: A three-level hierarchical RL framework using pose and interaction-point affordances to enable autonomous object manipulation (pedipulation) with quadruped robots, trained in IsaacSim and validated in real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 提出一种三级分层强化学习框架，利用姿态和交互点可供性，使四足机器人能够自主进行物体操作，在IsaacSim中训练并在真实场景中验证。
summary_zh: 四足机器人的物体操控能力是一个开放的研究挑战。以往研究主要关注底层策略学习，但任务执行仍依赖于专家设计的高层轨迹。通过自主选择目标物体上可行的交互点以及机器人可行的基座位姿，可以消除对预先设计轨迹的需求。本研究提出了一种三级分层强化学习框架，该框架利用位姿可供性来引导导航策略，而导航策略则驱动运动策略。此外，操控策略通过交互点可供性进行引导，实现了四足机器人的以物体为中心的位姿对齐与有效的末端执行器操控规划。我们在IsaacSim生态系统中训练所提出的框架，并在仿真和真实环境中进行评估。我们通过仿真中多个场景验证了位姿可供性的有效性，同时在真实环境中完成了多种物体交互任务，形成了物体交互数据集。结果表明，所提出的框架能够基于可供性自主识别候选位姿，并在无需人工引导的情况下在真实世界中成功执行物体操控任务。

title: Planning-aligned Token Compression for Long-Context Autonomous Driving
summary: Monolithic vision-action models represent an emerging paradigm in autonomous driving. However, this architecture produces token sequences that quickly exceed real-time computational budgets when encoding extended temporal context for complex interactions. While approaches like linear transformers and external memory try to make the context lightweight, token compression is most compatible with the architecture as it requires no backbone modifications. Yet existing compression adopts rule-based heuristics like temporal decay, decoupled from planning, risking loss of decision-critical information. We propose COMPACT-VA, a planning-aligned working memory framework built on conditional VQ-VAE, compressing extended context into bounded representations. Compression is conditioned on both historical trajectory and a learned planning intent that the posterior encoder distills from future trajectories during training, while the prior encoder learns to predict it from compressed observations. The compressed memory, concatenated with the predicted latent, feeds the policy for end-to-end optimization, planning with retained decision-critical information. We evaluate on high-signal dynamic scenarios where historical context is most critical for behavior correctness (e.g., stop, yield, or proceed), and accordingly design behavioral metrics. Under comparable token budgets, we achieve $>$6% improvement (68.3%) on success rates with consistent gains across metrics. Ablations validate planning-aligned coupling effectiveness. Closed-loop evaluation confirms that COMPACT-VA maintained general driving performance with 3.3* speedup and 2.7* memory reduction over uncompressed processing.
tldr: COMPACT-VA introduces a planning-aligned token compression framework using conditional VQ-VAE to reduce long-context token sequences in monolithic vision-action models for autonomous driving, achieving significant speedup and memory reduction while improving success rates in closed-loop evaluation.
tldr_zh: COMPACT-VA 提出了一种基于条件 VQ-VAE 的规划对齐令牌压缩框架，用于减少自动驾驶中单视觉-动作模型的长上下文令牌序列，在闭环评估中实现了显著的加速和内存减少，同时提高了成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
单目视觉-动作模型代表了自动驾驶领域的一种新兴范式。然而，当为复杂交互编码扩展时间上下文时，这种架构生成的令牌序列会迅速超出实时计算预算。尽管线性Transformer和外部记忆等方法试图降低上下文处理的轻量级成本，但令牌压缩与架构的兼容性最佳，因为它无需修改主干网络。然而，现有压缩方法采用基于规则的启发式策略（如时间衰减），且与规划模块解耦，可能导致决策关键信息的丢失。我们提出COMPACT-VA——一种基于条件VQ-VAE的规划对齐工作记忆框架，可将扩展上下文压缩为有界表征。压缩过程同时依赖于历史轨迹和一种学习得到的规划意图：后验编码器在训练期间从未来轨迹中提炼该意图，而先验编码器则学习通过压缩观测值预测该意图。压缩记忆与预测潜变量拼接后，输入策略网络进行端到端优化，从而在规划中保留决策关键信息。我们在历史上下文对行为正确性最为关键的高信号动态场景（如停车、减速让行或通行）中进行评估，并据此设计了行为指标。在相当的令牌预算下，我们的方法在成功率上提升了超过6%（达到68.3%），且各项指标一致增长。消融实验验证了规划对齐耦合的有效性。闭环评估证实，与未压缩处理相比，COMPACT-VA在保持通用驾驶性能的同时实现了3.3倍加速和2.7倍内存缩减。

title: Spline Policy: A Structured Representation for Robot Policies
summary: Modern imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation often represent actions as fixed-resolution action chunks, which are simple and effective but expose limited geometric and temporal structure before execution. This paper studies Spline Policy (SP), a structured representation that replaces action chunks with spline parameters while keeping the policy backbone unchanged. The predicted spline can be decoded as a compact continuous trajectory, queried at different temporal resolutions, constrained or edited in parameter space, and passed to downstream controllers. For quadratic spline outputs, the same representation can also be converted into a state-dependent vector field through an analytical distance-field construction. Under the regularity and projection assumptions of this construction, the induced dynamics do not increase the distance to the generated spline, yielding a principled local corrective mechanism around the predicted motion. The spline output further supports uncertainty propagation from observations to spline parameters, trajectories, and flow fields, and can be combined with classical control mechanisms such as null-space collision avoidance without retraining the policy backbone. We instantiate SP with diffusion, flow-matching, transformer-based, and vision-language-action backbones. Experiments in low-dimensional motion learning, simulated manipulation under matched backbones, dexterous manipulation, and real-robot case studies show that SP remains compatible with modern policy learners while exposing useful motion-structure properties, including compact decoding, temporal resampling, local correction around predicted motions, uncertainty evaluation, and controller compatibility.
tldr: Spline Policy replaces fixed-resolution action chunks with spline parameters in robot imitation learning policies, enabling continuous trajectory decoding, temporal resampling, and controller compatibility without changing the policy backbone.
tldr_zh: Spline Policy 将固定分辨率动作块替换为样条参数，在保持策略主干不变的情况下，实现了连续轨迹解码、时间重采样和控制器兼容性。
summary_zh: 现代机器人操作的模仿学习策略通常将动作表示为固定分辨率的动作块，这种方法简单有效，但在执行前仅暴露有限的几何与时间结构。本文研究了样条策略（SP），这是一种结构化表示方法，在保持策略主干不变的前提下，用样条参数替代动作块。预测的样条可解码为紧凑的连续轨迹，能在不同时间分辨率下查询、在参数空间中约束或编辑，并传递给下游控制器。对于二次样条输出，同一表示还可通过解析距离场构造转换为状态依赖向量场。在该构造的正则性和投影假设下，诱导动力学不会增加与生成样条的距离，从而在预测运动周围形成合理的局部修正机制。样条输出进一步支持从观测到样条参数、轨迹和流场的不确定性传播，并可结合经典控制机制（如零空间避障）而无需重新训练策略主干。我们采用扩散模型、流匹配、基于变换器以及视觉-语言-动作主干实例化SP。在低维运动学习、匹配主干下的模拟操作、灵巧操作及真实机器人案例研究中的实验表明，SP在保持与现代策略学习器兼容的同时，展现了有用的运动结构特性，包括紧凑解码、时间重采样、预测运动周围的局部修正、不确定性评估以及控制器兼容性。

title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC. RhinoVLA adopts a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone and a continuous Action Expert, reducing the VLM-side token and computation burden while preserving pretrained multimodal capability. To support cross-robot learning, RhinoVLA further introduces a unified interface that combines View Registry, 72D physical state-action slot space, and robotinstance LoRA, allowing heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas to be aligned under a shared policy. On the deployment side, RhinoVLA is optimized through hardware-aware compilation, mixed-precision execution, and parallel visual encoding. Experiments show that RhinoVLA achieves downstream performance comparable to π0.5 at a similar parameter scale, while reaching 11.69 Hz end-to-end inference on Huixi R1, meeting the 10 Hz real-time closedloop control target. The project will be open-sourced at https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA.
tldr: RhinoVLA proposes a token-efficient VLA model co-designed with an edge SoC, reducing latency via token pruning and hardware-aware optimization while maintaining manipulation performance comparable to π0.5.
tldr_zh: RhinoVLA 提出了一种与边缘 SoC 协同设计的 token 高效 VLA 模型，通过 token 精简和硬件感知优化降低延迟，同时保持与 π0.5 相当的操作性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域展现出巨大潜力，但在边缘硬件上的实时部署仍面临挑战。本研究发现，VLM视觉与上下文令牌是部署延迟的主要来源：对于以通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）为主的投影算子，在模型维度固定的条件下，计算量随输入令牌数量线性增长。基于这一观察，我们提出RhinoVLA——一种与慧犀R1边缘系统级芯片（SoC）协同设计的面向部署的VLA模型。RhinoVLA采用令牌高效的Qwen3-VL主干网络与连续动作专家模块，在保留预训练多模态能力的同时，降低了VLM侧的令牌数量与计算负担。为支持跨机器人学习，RhinoVLA进一步引入统一接口，该接口融合视图注册表、72维物理状态-动作槽空间及机器人实例LoRA模块，使异构机器人观测数据与动作模式可在共享策略下对齐。在部署层面，RhinoVLA通过硬件感知编译、混合精度执行与并行视觉编码进行优化。实验表明，RhinoVLA在相近参数量下实现了与π0.5相当的下游任务性能，同时在慧犀R1上达到11.69 Hz的端到端推理速度，满足10 Hz实时闭环控制目标。该项目将在https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA开源。

title: Dash2Sim: Closed-Loop Driving Simulation from in-the-wild Dashcam Videos
summary: Self-driving simulations typically rely on data collected in a small number of cities or on hand-authored synthetic scenarios. Dashcam videos cover a far broader range of locations and situations, including rare or long-tailed scenarios. They are considered less usable for simulation because it is difficult to recover accurate 4D scenes from monocular in-the-wild videos. Work zones are one such class of long-tailed situations that dashcams capture. We present Dash2Sim, a framework that turns in-the-wild monocular dashcam videos into metric, geo-referenced 4D driving logs compatible with existing simulators, and verifies eachone against an independently maintained map without annotations. We apply Dash2Sim to a large video corpus to create the ROADWork4D benchmark dataset, which spans 4,244 scenes with 2.7M 3D objects across 17 cities. On a verified subset ROADWork4D-CL (2,201 scenes), we study privileged closed-loop planners and find that work zone scenarios are difficult: while rule-based and hybrid planners generalize better than learning-based ones, all fall short, failing to make the lane changes that temporary work zone channels require. Beyond planning, dense depth recovered by Dash2Sim improves novel-view synthesis quality by up to 19% on perceptual metrics, suggesting its potential to provide rich conditioning for closed-loop sensor simulation from monocular videos.
tldr: Dash2Sim converts monocular dashcam videos into metric, geo-referenced 4D driving logs for closed-loop simulation, creating the ROADWork4D benchmark and revealing that current planners struggle with work zone lane changes.
tldr_zh: Dash2Sim将单目行车记录仪视频转换为度量、地理参考的4D驾驶日志以用于闭环仿真，创建了ROADWork4D基准，并揭示当前规划器在施工区变道场景中表现不足。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶模拟通常依赖于在少数城市收集的数据或手动编写的合成场景。行车记录仪视频涵盖了更广泛的地点和情境，包括稀有或长尾场景。这些视频被认为难以用于模拟，因为从单目野外视频中恢复精确的四维场景非常困难。工作区正是行车记录仪捕捉到的一类长尾场景。我们提出Dash2Sim框架，该框架能将野外单目行车记录仪视频转化为可与现有模拟器兼容的度量级、地理参考四维驾驶日志，并基于独立维护的地图对每个场景进行无标注验证。我们将Dash2Sim应用于大规模视频语料库，创建了ROADWork4D基准数据集，该数据集覆盖17个城市的4244个场景，包含270万个三维对象。在经验证的子集ROADWork4D-CL（2201个场景）上，我们研究了特权闭环规划器，发现工作区场景具有挑战性：虽然基于规则和混合规划器的泛化能力优于基于学习的方法，但所有方法均存在不足，无法完成临时工作区通道所需的变道操作。在规划之外，Dash2Sim恢复的密集深度可在感知指标上将新视角合成质量提升高达19%，这表明其具备为基于单目视频的闭环传感器模拟提供丰富条件信息的潜力。

title: CAPE: Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding for Embodied Planning
summary: Embodied agents need to predict the future consequences of candidate actions in order to plan effectively before execution. Existing visual dynamics models learn by reconstructing future visual states or rolling out dense latent representations, which spreads learning capacity across visually salient but planning-irrelevant content rather than the action-conditioned changes that drive manipulation outcomes. We propose CAPE, a Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding framework that learns visual dynamics by distinguishing the future outcomes induced by different action sequences. Given an initial observation and a candidate action sequence, CAPE decodes the full future latent trajectory in a single forward pass and is trained with a Goal-Convergent Contrastive Objective that aligns predictions corresponding to the same future outcome while separating those corresponding to different outcomes. On real-world DROID and zero-shot transfer to RoboCasa, CAPE substantially outperforms prior baselines on future-state retrieval, offline action matching, and closed-loop planning, while notably reducing planning-time inference cost at long prediction horizons.
tldr: CAPE proposes a contrastive action-conditioned parallel encoding framework for embodied planning that decodes future latent trajectories in a single forward pass and uses a goal-convergent contrastive objective to focus on action-relevant changes, achieving superior performance on real-world robotic tasks with reduced inference cost.
tldr_zh: CAPE提出了一种对比性动作条件并行编码框架，用于具身规划，在一次前向传播中解码未来潜在轨迹，并通过目标收敛对比目标聚焦于与动作相关的变化，在真实机器人任务上实现了更优性能并降低了推理成本。
summary_zh: 具身智能体需预测候选动作的未来后果，才能在执行前有效规划。现有视觉动态模型通过重构未来视觉状态或展开密集潜在表征进行学习，这将学习能力分散在视觉显著但无关规划的内容上，而非驱动操作结果的行动条件变化。我们提出CAPE——一种对比性行动条件并行编码框架，通过区分不同动作序列引发的未来结果来学习视觉动态。给定初始观测与候选动作序列，CAPE通过单次前向传播解码完整未来潜在轨迹，并采用目标收敛对比训练目标，使对应相同未来结果的预测相互对齐，同时分离对应不同结果的预测。在真实世界DROID数据集及对RoboCasa的零样本迁移任务中，CAPE在未来状态检索、离线动作匹配及闭环规划方面显著超越先前基线，同时显著降低了长预测时域下的规划阶段推理成本。

title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling general-purpose policies trained from large corpora of demonstrations and action labels. However, adapting these models to new tasks still typically requires task-specific demonstrations, action annotations, and additional fine-tuning, making deployment costly and difficult to scale.
  We propose WIZARD, a weight-space meta-learning framework that sidesteps task-specific fine-tuning by generating task-specific LoRA parameters for a frozen VLA policy. Given only a language instruction and a short demonstration video, WIZARD predicts the corresponding adaptation weights in a single forward pass, without target-task action labels or test-time optimization. During meta-training, WIZARD learns to map task evidence directly to expert LoRA updates, capturing relationships between tasks in weight space.
  Experiments on LIBERO show that WIZARD improves performance by up to ~2x on unseen dataset collections and up to ~14x on unseen tasks. On a Franka Emika Panda, WIZARD consistently improves over a real-domain adapted baseline, showing that generated adapters provide task-level specialization beyond simulation.
tldr: WIZARD meta-learns to generate task-specific LoRA weights for a frozen VLA policy from a language instruction and a demonstration video, eliminating target-task fine-tuning and action labels.
tldr_zh: WIZARD 通过元学习，仅凭语言指令和演示视频为冻结的 VLA 策略生成任务特定的 LoRA 权重，免去了目标任务的微调和动作标签需求。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正成为机器人操作领域一种前景广阔的范式，能够基于大规模演示和动作标签语料库训练通用策略。然而，将这些模型适配到新任务通常仍需要任务特定的演示、动作标注以及额外的微调，这使得部署成本高昂且难以规模化扩展。

我们提出WIZARD——一种权重空间元学习框架，通过为冻结的VLA策略生成任务特定的LoRA参数，从而规避任务特定微调。仅需一条语言指令和一段简短演示视频，WIZARD即可在单次前向传播中预测对应的适配权重，无需目标任务的动作标签或测试时优化。在元训练阶段，WIZARD学习将任务证据直接映射到专家级LoRA更新，在权重空间中捕获任务间的关系。

在LIBERO上的实验表明，WIZARD在未见数据集上的性能提升高达约2倍，在未见任务上提升高达约14倍。在Franka Emika Panda机器人上，WIZARD相比真实域适配基线持续提升性能，表明生成的适配器能够提供超越仿真环境的任务级专精化能力。

title: A Causal Probabilistic Framework for Perception-Informed Closed-Loop Simulation of Autonomous Driving
summary: Software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulation is a cornerstone for the validation of modern automotive safety functions. However, many current frameworks utilize ideal sensing, which bypasses the functional insufficiencies of perception algorithms, leading to over-optimistic safety assessments. This paper proposes a perception-informed SIL testing methodology that bridges the gap between ground-truth simulation and real-world perception behavior. We present a framework for incorporating causal probabilistic models into standardized, scenario-based simulation toolchains, applicable to both Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS). Our approach enables the systematic injection of realistic perception errors, such as loss of detection, sizing inaccuracies, and positioning offsets, derived from physical triggering conditions like fog, rain, and object-merging scenarios. By evaluating these ``faults'' within a standardized simulation environment, we demonstrate that perception-informed testing reveals latent operational risks that ideal SIL environments fail to capture, providing a scalable pathway for SOTIF (ISO 21448) validation.
tldr: This paper introduces a causal probabilistic framework to incorporate realistic perception errors into closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving, enabling more accurate SOTIF validation compared to ideal sensing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个因果概率框架，将真实的感知错误注入自动驾驶闭环仿真中，从而比理想传感器仿真更准确地评估SOTIF安全性。
summary_zh: 软件在环（SIL）仿真是现代汽车安全功能验证的基石。然而，当前许多框架采用理想化感知模型，绕开了感知算法的功能缺陷，导致安全评估过于乐观。本文提出一种融入感知信息的SIL测试方法，弥合了真实仿真与现实感知行为之间的鸿沟。我们构建了一个将因果概率模型集成至标准化场景仿真工具链的框架，该框架可应用于高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）和自动驾驶系统（ADS）。该方法基于雾、雨及物体遮挡等物理触发条件，能够系统性地注入真实感知误差，例如检测丢失、尺寸不准确和定位偏移。通过在标准化仿真环境中评估这些“故障”，我们证明了融入感知信息的测试能够揭示理想化SIL环境无法捕捉的潜在运行风险，为SOTIF（ISO 21448）验证提供了一条可扩展的路径。

title: Test-Time Trajectory Optimization for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end planners for autonomous driving typically generate a set of candidate trajectories, score each one, and return the highest-scoring candidate. However, the scorer is applied only after the proposals are generated and cannot influence the set of trajectories: a weak set of candidates limits planning performance regardless of the scorer's quality. We instead treat the scorer as a learned trajectory-level reward function and search for trajectories that maximize it. Our method, TOAD, runs the Cross-Entropy Method at test time, warm-started from the planner's proposals. It requires no retraining and is plug-and-play for existing planners. Across six base planners, TOAD improves results on NAVSIM-v1 (94.7 PDMS), NAVSIM-v2 (56.3 EPDMS), and the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark. The code will be made publicly available via the project page: https://valeoai.github.io/TOAD/.
tldr: TOAD treats the scorer in end-to-end autonomous driving planners as a learned reward function and applies the Cross-Entropy Method at test time to optimize trajectories, improving planning performance across multiple base planners.
tldr_zh: TOAD将端到端自动驾驶规划器中的评分器视为一个学习到的奖励函数，并在测试时应用交叉熵方法优化轨迹，从而在多个基础规划器上提升规划性能。
summary_zh: 面向自动驾驶的端到端规划器通常生成一组候选轨迹，对每条轨迹进行评分，并返回得分最高的候选轨迹。然而，评分器仅在生成候选轨迹后应用，无法影响轨迹集：无论评分器质量如何，薄弱的候选集都会限制规划性能。我们转而将评分器视为一种学习到的轨迹级奖励函数，并搜索能使其最大化的轨迹。提出的方法TOAD在测试时运行交叉熵方法，并以规划器的候选轨迹作为热启动。该方法无需重新训练，可作为现有规划器的即插即用模块。在六个基础规划器上，TOAD在NAVSIM-v1（94.7 PDMS）、NAVSIM-v2（56.3 EPDMS）以及闭环HUGSIM基准测试中均取得了性能提升。代码将通过项目页面公开提供：https://valeoai.github.io/TOAD/。

title: QuadVerse: An Integrated Framework Aligning Visual-Physical Reality for Quadruped Simulation
summary: Simulation is central to robot learning, yet the sim-to-real gap remains a major bottleneck.Existing approaches often tackle visual or dynamic gaps separately, overlooking how these individual mismatches accumulate and propagate throughout the robot's state evolution.In this paper, we introduce QuadVerse, an integrated framework that uses reconstructed scenes as a calibration substrate for aligning visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics.From captured RGB videos, we reconstruct geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes that support batched photorealistic ego-view rendering and collision-ready semantic mesh extraction. The meshes further enable contact calibration by initializing spatially varying friction priors and refining them through trajectory-based posterior search.To address remaining actuator discrepancies, QuadVerse trains a residual dynamics compensator by replaying real-world trajectories on the contact-calibrated terrain, reducing the entanglement between terrain-induced contact errors and actuator non-idealities.Experiments show that QuadVerse improves reconstruction quality and locomotion tracking over relevant baselines.Leveraging this foundation, we demonstrate robust zero-shot visual-navigation policy deployment without task-specific real-world rollouts.
tldr: QuadVerse is an integrated framework that aligns visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics using reconstructed 3DGS scenes and contact calibration to reduce the sim-to-real gap for quadruped locomotion, enabling zero-shot deployment of visual-navigation policies.
tldr_zh: QuadVerse是一个集成框架，通过重建3DGS场景和接触校准来对齐视觉感知、物理交互和驱动器动力学，减少四足机器人运动控制的仿真到现实差距，实现视觉导航策略的零样本部署。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
仿真在机器人学习中占据核心地位，但仿真到现实的差距仍是主要瓶颈。现有方法通常分别处理视觉或动力学差异，忽视了这些个体不匹配如何在整个机器人状态演化过程中累积与传播。本文提出QuadVerse，一个集成框架，利用重建场景作为校准基板，以对齐视觉感知、物理交互与执行器动力学。从采集的RGB视频中，我们重建几何约束下的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景，支持批量逼真的自我视角渲染与可碰撞语义网格提取。该网格通过初始化空间变化的摩擦先验，并基于轨迹后验搜索进行优化，进一步实现接触校准。为解决剩余的执行器差异，QuadVerse在接触校准后的地形上重放真实世界轨迹，训练残差动力学补偿器，从而减少地形引发的接触误差与执行器非理想特性之间的耦合。实验表明，QuadVerse在重建质量与运动跟踪性能上优于相关基线。基于该基础，我们展示了无需特定任务真实世界数据即可实现鲁棒的零样本视觉导航策略部署。

title: Coarse-to-Control: Action-Token Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models map observations directly to actions without explicit intermediate planning, which limits performance on long-horizon tasks where early mistakes compound. We propose Coarse-to-Control, a plan-execute VLA that introduces planning natively in the action-token space. The key idea is to let the policy first predict a compact sequence of coarse action tokens that summarize the intended future trajectory, and then generate executable action tokens conditioned on this plan. Because both planning and execution share a unified discrete action vocabulary, the plan stays close to the control manifold and provides directly actionable guidance rather than an abstract hint that must be translated back to motor commands. Experiments on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-WidowX, and real-world manipulation tasks show that action-token planning consistently improves over direct action generation, with the largest gains on long-horizon multi-stage tasks.
tldr: This paper proposes Coarse-to-Control, a VLA model that first predicts coarse action tokens as a plan and then generates fine-grained action tokens, improving performance on long-horizon manipulation tasks in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Coarse-to-Control，一种先预测粗粒度动作令牌作为计划，再生成细粒度动作令牌的VLA模型，在仿真和真实世界的长程操控任务中提升了性能。
summary_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接将观测映射为动作，缺乏显式的中间规划，这限制了其在早期错误会累积的长时域任务中的表现。我们提出Coarse-to-Control，一种在动作标记空间中原生引入规划的执行-规划型VLA。其核心思想是让策略首先预测一个紧凑的粗粒度动作标记序列，用以概括预期的未来轨迹，然后基于该规划生成可执行的动作标记。由于规划与执行共享统一的离散动作词汇表，该规划紧贴控制流形，提供的是可直接指导行动的信息，而非必须重新转化为运动指令的抽象提示。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv-WidowX以及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，基于动作标记的规划一致优于直接生成动作，在长时域多阶段任务中提升最为显著。

title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr: LARA is a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes latent action models and vision-language-action models via representation alignment, improving VLA pre-training and post-training on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: LARA 是一种即插即用的框架，通过表示对齐联合优化潜在动作模型和视觉-语言-动作模型，改进了机器人操作任务上的 VLA 预训练和后训练。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够直接从观测数据和语言指令预测动作，但其性能依赖于大规模、高质量的数据集，并且受限于现实世界机器人动作数据集的稀缺性。为利用丰富的无标注人类视频促进VLA模型学习，潜在动作模型（LAM）从视觉动态中学习潜在动作表征，为VLA学习提供额外监督。然而，LAM与VLA通常分开训练，导致LAM在VLA训练过程中缺乏根基，而VLA模型受限于冻结的LAM表征。针对这些问题，我们提出潜在动作表征对齐（LARA）——一种即插即用框架，通过表征对齐联合优化LAM与VLA。该方法实现双向增益：LAM借助动作轨迹学习以规避虚假视觉变化，VLA则通过LAM学习的前向动力学进行正则化，减少功能无效轨迹的幻觉。我们验证了LARA在预训练、预训练VLA模型的后训练增强以及LAM优化中的通用性与有效性，在3个仿真基准测试和1个精心设计的真实机器人操作基准测试中，分别实现平均约10%、5%和15%的性能提升。

title: Dreaming when Necessary: Advancing World Action Models with Adaptive Multi-Modal Reasoning
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to embodied intelligence, yet existing methods rely heavily on video prediction as action priors and lack adaptive multimodal reasoning, limiting their effectiveness on long-horizon, complex tasks. We observe that WAMs require different multimodal reasoning modes under different execution contexts: textual reasoning is essential during task transitions to guide high-level action prediction, while visual reasoning is critical during fine-grained manipulation for precise control. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{AdaWAM}, a world action model with adaptive multimodal reasoning abilities. AdaWAM integrates a lightweight dynamic router that autonomously triggers textual or visual reasoning as needed during task execution. Experiments on both simulated and real-world embodied tasks show that AdaWAM substantially improves inference efficiency while outperforming state-of-the-art embodied policies. Codes and demos are available at: https://adawam.github.io/.
tldr: AdaWAM proposes a world action model with adaptive multimodal reasoning that dynamically switches between textual and visual reasoning depending on the task phase, improving efficiency and performance on long-horizon embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: AdaWAM 提出了一种具有自适应多模态推理能力的世界动作模型，根据任务阶段动态切换文本或视觉推理，提升了长周期具身任务的效率和性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）为具身智能提供了有前景的解决方案，但现有方法过度依赖视频预测作为动作先验，缺乏自适应多模态推理能力，这限制了其在长周期复杂任务中的有效性。我们观察到WAM在不同执行场景下需要不同模态的推理模式：在任务转换阶段，文本推理对指导高层动作预测至关重要；而在精细操作阶段，视觉推理是实现精准控制的关键。基于这一发现，我们提出\textbf{AdaWAM}——一种具备自适应多模态推理能力的世界动作模型。AdaWAM集成了轻量级动态路由器，可在任务执行过程中自主触发文本或视觉推理。在仿真与真实世界具身任务上的实验表明，AdaWAM显著提升了推理效率，同时性能超越了现有最优的具身策略。代码与演示请访问：https://adawam.github.io/。

title: Predictive Style Matching: Natural and Robust Humanoid Locomotion
summary:
Reinforcement learning has become the prevailing approach to humanoid locomotion control: policies transfer reliably from simulation to hardware and recover gracefully from disturbances.
  Motion quality, however, still lags behind: task-only rewards often converge to stiff, asymmetric gaits, while motion imitation methods improve appearance but become more sensitive to external disturbances because reference signals can oppose the transient poses needed to regain balance.
  We propose Predictive Style Matching, in which an offline predictor maps the robot's lower-body state history and velocity commands to interpretable upper-body joint and gait targets that shape the rewards during training.
  Because the targets are state-conditioned rather than time-indexed and the predictor is used only at training time, the deployed controller inherits the proprioceptive interface and inference cost of a task-only RL baseline.
  On the Unitree G1, in both simulation and hardware, PSM reduces upper-body style error by roughly an order of magnitude over task-only RL while preserving its fall-recovery rate, whereas the motion-imitation baseline attains the lowest style error but fails to recover from disturbances about five times as often.
tldr: PSM uses an offline predictor to compute state-conditioned upper-body and gait targets from lower-body history, yielding natural humanoid locomotion that matches motion-imitation style while preserving task-only RL's robustness to disturbances.
tldr_zh: PSM 利用离线预测器根据下半身历史状态生成状态依赖的上半身和步态目标，在保持任务导向 RL 鲁棒性的同时实现接近运动模仿的自然人形机器人步态。
summary_zh: 强化学习已成为人形机器人运动控制的主流方法：策略能够可靠地从仿真迁移至硬件，且能优雅地从干扰中恢复。然而，运动质量仍存在不足：仅依赖任务奖励的优化往往收敛至僵硬、不对称的步态；而运动模仿方法虽改善了外观，却因参考信号可能对抗维持平衡所需的瞬态姿态，导致对外部干扰的敏感性增加。我们提出预测性风格匹配方法，通过离线预测器将机器人下半身状态历史与速度指令映射为可解释的上半身关节与步态目标，从而在训练过程中塑造奖励函数。由于目标基于状态条件而非时间索引，且预测器仅在训练阶段使用，部署后的控制器继承了纯任务强化学习基线原有的本体感觉接口与推理成本。在Unitree G1机器人（含仿真与硬件平台）上，PSM将上半身风格误差较纯任务强化学习降低约一个数量级，同时保持其坠落恢复率；而运动模仿基线虽达到最低风格误差，但其从干扰中恢复的失败频率约为前者的五倍。

title: Extending Responsibility-Sensitive Safety for the Assessment of Offloaded Autonomous Driving Services
summary: Safety is a fundamental requirement in the development of autonomous driving (AD) systems. While function offloading has demonstrated significant benefits in terms of computational efficiency and energy consumption, its application to safety-critical AD functionality introduces new challenges. In particular, offloaded service compositions incur increased and variable response times due to wireless vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, which directly affects the vehicle's reaction time and thus its safety guarantees. In this paper, we address this challenge by extending the definitions of Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS) to explicitly account for different response times of local and offloaded AD service compositions. Based on this extension, we propose an integration into function offloading, using the RSS safety constraints for offloading decision-making and fallback mechanisms. Offloaded service compositions are only permitted if the current traffic situation remains safe under the corresponding end-to-end response time. If this condition is violated, the system performs a controlled fallback to local execution. Furthermore, we introduce an enhanced fallback strategy that includes a warm-standby phase for offloaded services, enabling faster and safer transitions from offloaded to local services. The proposed approach is integrated into our AD stack and evaluated in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves safety compared to state-of-the-art function offloading and safety frameworks, while preserving the benefits of distributed computation when safety conditions allow.
tldr: This paper extends Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS) to account for variable response times in offloaded autonomous driving services, integrating safety constraints into offloading decisions and fallback mechanisms for safer distributed AD systems.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了责任敏感安全（RSS）以考虑自动驾驶服务卸载中可变的响应时间，将安全约束整合到卸载决策和回退机制中，以实现更安全的分布式自动驾驶系统。
summary_zh: 安全是自动驾驶系统开发中的基本要求。尽管功能卸载在计算效率和能耗方面展现出显著优势，但其在安全关键型自动驾驶功能中的应用也带来了新的挑战。特别是，由于无线车联网通信导致卸载服务组合的响应时间增加且具有可变性，这会直接影响车辆的反应时间，进而影响其安全保证。本文通过扩展责任敏感安全定义，明确区分本地与卸载自动驾驶服务组合的不同响应时间，从而应对这一挑战。基于该扩展，我们提出将RSS安全约束集成至功能卸载中，用于卸载决策制定和回退机制。仅当当前交通场景在相应端到端响应时间下保持安全时，才允许执行卸载服务组合；若该条件被违反，系统将执行受控回退至本地执行。此外，我们引入了一种增强型回退策略，该策略包含针对卸载服务的热备用阶段，可实现从卸载服务到本地服务的更快、更安全切换。所提方法已集成至我们的自动驾驶技术栈中，并在仿真和真实环境中进行了评估。实验结果表明，与现有先进的功能卸载和安全框架相比，所提方法在提升安全性的同时，能在安全条件允许时保持分布式计算的优势。

title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance Framework for Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper studies runtime safety for autonomous driving when high-level driving commands become faulty or unreliable. Unlike conventional runtime-safety approaches that mainly focus on immediate vehicle safety, the proposed framework evaluates both driving safety and whether the vehicle can still successfully complete its mission before a command is executed. The framework extends highway-env with mission-level fault scenarios such as skipping required checkpoints, entering restricted areas, and generating future routes that can no longer complete the mission successfully. A runtime monitoring system is introduced to detect and reject unsafe or mission-infeasible commands before execution. For comparison, an adapted Simplex-Drive runtime-safety baseline with learning-based driving control, safety fallback control, and runtime controller switching is implemented using the public Simplex-Drive framework. Experimental results show that platform-level runtime safety alone cannot detect mission-level planning faults, while the proposed framework successfully rejects mission-infeasible commands and improves mission success under randomized fault conditions.
tldr: This paper proposes a mission-level runtime assurance framework for autonomous driving that detects and rejects unsafe or mission-infeasible commands before execution, improving mission success under faulty high-level commands.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向自动驾驶的使命级运行时保障框架，在执行前检测并拒绝不安全或无法完成使命的命令，从而在高层指令故障下提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 本文研究了自动驾驶中高级驾驶指令出现故障或不可靠时的运行时安全性问题。与主要关注即时车辆安全的传统运行时安全方法不同，所提出的框架在指令执行前同时评估驾驶安全性以及车辆是否仍能成功完成其任务。该框架在highway-env基础上扩展了任务级故障场景，例如跳过必需检查点、进入限制区域以及生成无法再成功完成任务的未来路线。引入了一种运行时监控系统，用于在执行前检测并拒绝不安全或任务不可行的指令。为进行比较，利用公开的Simplex-Drive框架实现了一种基于学习型驾驶控制、安全回退控制及运行时控制器切换的改进Simplex-Drive运行时安全基线。实验结果表明，仅靠平台级运行时安全无法检测任务级规划故障，而所提出的框架能够成功拒绝任务不可行的指令，并在随机故障条件下提升任务成功率。

title: T-GMP: Terrain-conditioned Generative Motion Priors for Versatile and Natural Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Achieving both anthropomorphic naturalness and robust terrain traversal remains a fundamental challenge in humanoid locomotion. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches typically rely on fixed motion priors, limiting their adaptability to varying environments. We propose Terrain-conditioned Generative Motion Priors (T-GMP), a module that captures a terrain-conditioned latent motion manifold from a few expert state-terrain demonstrations using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). The learned priors enable smooth style transitions, facilitating a unified policy that adapts to terrain variations. We integrate T-GMP into an adversarial learning pipeline with our proposed Foothold Penalty, where a discriminator dynamically modulates naturalness constraints conditioned on local terrain features, guiding the generation of versatile and human-like motions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines in traversal success rate and motion smoothness, while preserving biomimetically natural and physically coordinated motions.
tldr: T-GMP uses a CVAE to learn terrain-conditioned motion priors from few expert demonstrations, enabling a unified humanoid locomotion policy that adapts smoothly to varying terrains while maintaining natural, biomimetic motion.
tldr_zh: T-GMP 利用 CVAE 从少量专家演示中学习地形条件化的运动先验，使双足机器人能够通过单一策略平滑适应不同地形，同时保持自然、仿生的步态。
summary_zh: 实现类人自然步态与稳健地形穿越的平衡，仍是人形机器人运动控制中的核心挑战。现有强化学习方法通常依赖固定运动先验，限制了其适应不同环境的能力。我们提出地形条件生成运动先验（T-GMP），该模块通过条件变分自编码器（CVAE）从少量专家状态-地形示范中提取地形条件隐式运动流形。所学先验支持平滑步态切换，从而促进能够适应地形变化的统一策略。我们将T-GMP集成至对抗学习框架中，并结合所提出的立足点惩罚项：判别器根据局部地形特征动态调节自然性约束，引导生成多样且类人的运动。实验结果表明，本方法在穿越成功率与运动平滑度方面均优于现有基线方法，同时保持了仿生自然且物理协调的运动特性。

title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap.
tldr: ActionMap replaces the standard action decoder in VLA models with a voxel heatmap head that leverages geometric action structure, consistently improving performance across different backbones and data regimes on LIBERO and real Franka tasks.
tldr_zh: ActionMap 用体素热图头替换现有 VLA 模型中的标准动作解码器，利用动作空间的几何结构，在 LIBERO 仿真和真实 Franka 任务中跨不同骨干网络和数据规模一致地提升性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在主干网络、训练策略和数据规模方面取得了快速发展，然而将主干网络隐藏状态转换为连续控制信号的动作解码器却几乎没有变化，在目前绝大多数VLA中仍保持单点预测形式。无论采用自回归分箱、L1回归还是流匹配去噪实现，现有解码器都将动作空间视为非结构化结构，在训练过程中未能利用相邻动作的几何邻近性。为此，我们提出ActionMap——一种体素热力图动作头，可替换现有VLA的原生动作解码器。对于每个新动作，该动作头在动作空间上预测一个体素热力图，其中每个体素直接存储对应动作的概率。在LIBERO仿真和真实Franka操作实验中，我们的热力图头在相同训练步数下超越两个架构不同的主干网络（例如，在LIBERO四任务套件平均得分上比OpenVLA-OFT的L1回归头高8.2%），在两个主干网络上均以相当或更快的速度收敛，并在低训练数据量下保持显著更高的数据效率。跨主干网络的一致性表明，动作表征是提升VLA性能的有效杠杆，独立于进一步扩展主干网络或训练策略。项目页面：https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Task Planning Under Complex Logical Constraints
summary: Task planning often suffers from severe efficiency bottlenecks when robots must reason over long-horizon action sequences under complex logical constraints, including object affordances, spatial relationships, and sequential action dependencies. Recent neuro-symbolic methods improve planning efficiency by learning object-importance scores to prune task-irrelevant objects, but they typically rely on fixed offline supervision generated from full search spaces. This creates a train-test mismatch: at deployment, the planner operates in pruned search spaces induced by the model's own imperfect predictions, leading to exposure bias and degraded planning performance. To address this challenge, we formulate object-importance learning for task planning as an imperative learning-based bilevel optimization problem. The upper level optimizes a neural scorer, while the lower level solves a symbolic planning problem in the score-pruned search space. To stabilize this learning process, we introduce a 3R strategy into the lower-level planning, using parallel Repair, Restart, and Rollback recovery to provide reliable and adaptive feedback for upper-level learning. Experiments on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, including an 80.04% reduction in failure rate and a 57.14% reduction in planning time. We further validate the framework on a quadruped-based mobile manipulator in simulation and the real world, demonstrating its potential for efficient and deployable neuro-symbolic task planning.
tldr: This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic learning framework for long-horizon robotic task planning, formulating object-importance learning as a bilevel optimization problem and using a 3R strategy to mitigate exposure bias. It achieves significant reductions in failure rate and planning time on benchmarks and is validated on a quadruped mobile manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出了一种面向长时域机器人任务规划的神经符号学习框架，将物体重要性学习建模为双层优化问题，并采用3R策略缓解曝光偏差。在基准测试中实现了失败率80.04%和规划时间57.14%的显著降低，并在四足移动操作平台上完成了仿真与实物验证。
summary_zh: 当机器人需要在复杂的逻辑约束（包括物体可供性、空间关系以及顺序动作依赖）下对长时域动作序列进行推理时，任务规划常面临严重的效率瓶颈。最近的神经符号方法通过学习物体重要性分数来剪枝与任务无关的物体，从而提升规划效率，但这些方法通常依赖从完整搜索空间生成的固定离线监督信号。这导致了训练与测试之间的不匹配：在部署阶段，规划器需要在该模型自身不完美预测所诱导出的剪枝搜索空间内运行，从而产生暴露偏差并导致规划性能下降。为解决这一挑战，我们将任务规划的物体重要性学习建模为一个基于命令性学习的双层优化问题。上层优化一个神经评分器，下层则在经评分剪枝的搜索空间中求解一个符号规划问题。为稳定这一学习过程，我们在下层规划中引入3R策略，通过并行修复、重启与回滚恢复机制为上层学习提供可靠且自适应的反馈。在三个具有挑战性的基准测试上的实验展示了最先进的性能，包括降低80.04%的失败率和减少57.14%的规划时间。我们进一步在仿真和现实环境中基于四足移动操作平台验证了该框架，展示了其在高效且可部署的神经符号任务规划方面的潜力。

title: Think Like a Pilot: Fine-Grained Long-Horizon UAV Navigation
summary: Language-guided UAV agents must execute long-horizon semantic instructions while producing smooth, physically feasible continuous flight commands, yet existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) benchmarks typically use discrete or coarse actions and existing UAV Vision-Language-Action (VLA) tasks focus on short, atomic maneuvers. To address this gap in UAV task settings, we introduce \textbf{FLIGHT}, a \textbf{F}ine-grained \textbf{L}ong-horizon \textbf{I}nstruction-\textbf{G}uided benchmark for \textbf{H}ybrid UAV navigation and reasoning \textbf{T}asks, which combines multi-stage instructions with dense 6-DoF trajectory annotations across two dataset splits: Fine-grained VLN and Long-horizon Flow. To endow the UAV agent with the capability of real-time in-flight reasoning over task execution status and mission planning, while simultaneously accommodating high-frequency, real-time precise control, we further propose \textbf{FLIGHT VLA}, an asynchronous architecture that decouples a low-frequency Streaming Pilot Vision-Language Model (VLM) for task-state reasoning from a high-frequency diffusion action model for continuous control, supervised by explicit \textbf{Pilot Reasoning} texts that summarize the current flight state and anticipate the next subgoal. In closed-loop evaluation, FLIGHT VLA consistently surpasses representative VLN and VLA baselines on our FLIGHT benchmarks, achieving stronger multi-stage completion, subgoal adherence, and terminal control. Its trained Streaming Pilot Reasoning VLM further improves UAV video reasoning, validating the effectiveness of our design.
tldr: Introduces FLIGHT, a fine-grained long-horizon instruction-guided benchmark for UAV navigation with 6-DoF trajectories, and FLIGHT VLA, an asynchronous architecture with a streaming VLM for reasoning and a diffusion action model for control.
tldr_zh: 提出了FLIGHT，一个用于无人机导航的细粒度长视界指令引导基准，包含6自由度轨迹，以及FLIGHT VLA，一种解耦流式VLM推理和扩散动作模型的异步架构。
summary_zh: 语言驱动的无人机智能体需在生成长时程语义指令的同时，生成平滑且物理可行的连续飞行指令。然而，现有视觉语言导航（VLN）基准通常采用离散或粗粒度动作，而现有无人机视觉-语言-动作（VLA）任务聚焦于短时、原子的机动操作。为解决无人机任务设定中的这一空白，我们提出**FLIGHT**——面向无人机混合导航与推理任务的**细粒度长时程指令引导基准**，该基准结合多阶段指令与密集的6自由度轨迹标注，包含两个数据集分支：细粒度VLN与长时程流。为使无人机智能体具备对任务执行状态与任务规划的实时飞行中推理能力，同时适应高频、实时的精确控制需求，我们进一步提出**FLIGHT VLA**——一种异步架构，将用于任务状态推理的低频流式驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）与用于连续控制的高频扩散动作模型解耦，并通过显式**驾驶推理**文本（总结当前飞行状态并预测下一子目标）进行监督。在闭环评估中，FLIGHT VLA在FLIGHT基准上持续超越代表性VLN与VLA基线方法，在多阶段任务完成、子目标遵循与终端控制方面表现更优。其训练的流式驾驶推理VLM进一步提升了无人机视频推理能力，验证了本设计的有效性。

title: STRIPS-WM: Learning Grounded Propositional STRIPS-style World Models from Images
summary: Robots performing long-horizon visual manipulation observe high-dimensional images, but successful plans depend on action-relevant facts: what can be done now and what changes afterward. A useful planning representation should discard irrelevant visual details while preserving action applicability and effects. Classical task planners exploit this structure through symbolic operators with preconditions and effects, but obtaining such representations from raw visual experience remains challenging. We study a visual task-planning setting in which a robot receives only image transitions: the current image, executed high-level action, and the resulting image. At test time, given a start image and a goal image, the robot must produce a sequence of high-level actions that reaches the goal. To address this problem, we introduce STRIPS-WM, a framework for learning image-grounded STRIPS-style world models directly from visual transitions. STRIPS-WM first induces a finite abstract transition graph from images, then learns latent binary predicates and one grounded propositional operator per action label. The learned operators form a symbolic action model with sparse preconditions and add/delete effects. Finally, the learned predicates are distilled into a visual encoder, enabling classical planning directly from novel start and goal images. Experiments on visual rearrangement tasks show that STRIPS-WM improves image-to-plan success over the tested visual rollout, latent graph-search and latent-symbolic baselines.
tldr: STRIPS-WM learns symbolic STRIPS-style world models from image transitions, enabling classical planning for visual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: STRIPS-WM从图像转换中学习符号化的STRIPS风格世界模型，从而实现视觉操作任务的经典规划。
summary_zh: 机器人执行长时域视觉操作任务时，需处理高维图像，但成功规划依赖于与动作相关的关键信息：当前可执行的操作及其后续影响。有效的规划表示应摒弃无关视觉细节，同时保留动作的适用性与效果。经典任务规划器通过包含前提条件与效果的符号算子利用这一结构，但如何从原始视觉经验中获取此类表示仍具挑战性。本研究探讨了一个视觉任务规划场景：机器人仅接收图像状态转换数据——当前图像、已执行的高层动作及结果图像。在测试阶段，给定初始图像与目标图像，机器人需生成一系列高层动作序列以达成目标。为解决这一问题，我们提出STRIPS-WM框架，该框架可直接从视觉转换中学习基于图像的STRIPS风格世界模型。STRIPS-WM首先从图像中归纳出有限抽象转换图，随后学习潜在二值谓词，并为每个动作标签学习一个基于命题的算子。学习所得算子构成具有稀疏前提条件及增删效果的符号化动作模型。最后，将学习到的谓词蒸馏至视觉编码器中，使机器人能够直接基于新颖的初始与目标图像执行经典规划。在视觉重排任务上的实验表明，与测试的视觉展开、潜在图搜索及潜在符号基线方法相比，STRIPS-WM在图像到规划的成功率上表现更优。

title: Three-dimensional hydro-cluttered locomotion by an undulatory robot
summary: Aquatic robots have expanded human access to underwater environments, yet many underwater spaces contain obstacles that can disrupt open-water locomotion. In "hydro-cluttered" environments, water is interspersed with rigid and flexible clutter, making body-obstacle contact unavoidable. Operating in these spaces requires robots that can regulate and exploit contact, but this regime remains difficult to model or simulate. Building on recent advances in mechanical intelligence in terradynamically capable limbless robotics, we develop principles for 3D aquatic locomotion using AquaMILR, an elongate limbless robot that combines bilateral cable-driven actuation, programmable body compliance, distributed depth regulation, corrosion-resistant enclosures, and onboard power and electronics for untethered field operation. Systematic robophysical experiments reveal that programmable body compliance regulates body deformation and converts body-environment interactions into fast, robust, forward progression across increasing hydro-clutter constraint strength. Depth regulation provides three-dimensional access, allowing the robot to bypass clutter, recover from obstruction, and continue through otherwise inaccessible routes. In potential jamming scenarios, emergent inertia-induced rolling acts as a spontaneous recovery mechanism, freeing the robot from clutter that would otherwise lead to failure and allowing locomotion to continue without additional control. Tests of the robot in an aquatic mangrove field demonstrate that these principles transfer to practical operation, enabling navigation and onboard visual inspection of inaccessible root zones. These results establish principles for hydro-cluttered locomotion and a design paradigm in which aquatic robots exploit environmental complexity as a locomotor resource.
tldr: This paper presents design and control principles for an undulatory robot that achieves robust 3D locomotion in hydro-cluttered environments by exploiting programmable body compliance and depth regulation, demonstrated through robophysical experiments and field tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种波动式机器人在水中杂乱环境中实现稳健三维运动的原理，通过可编程身体柔顺性和深度调节来利用环境接触，并通过机器人物理实验和实地测试验证。
summary_zh: 水下机器人已拓展了人类进入水下环境的能力，但许多水下空间存在障碍物，可能干扰开阔水域中的运动。在"水体杂散"环境中，水体中散布着刚性或柔性杂物，导致身体与障碍物的接触难以避免。在此类空间作业要求机器人能够调节并利用接触，然而这种运动机制仍难以建模或模拟。基于近期陆面运动能力突出的无肢机器人在机械智能方面的进展，我们利用AquaMILR（一种细长无肢机器人）开发了三维水下运动原理。该机器人融合了双侧缆索驱动、可编程身体柔顺性、分布式深度调节、耐腐蚀密封舱体，以及用于无缆现场作业的机载电源与电子设备。系统的机器人物理实验表明，可编程身体柔顺性能够调控身体形变，并将身体-环境相互作用转化为快速、稳健的前向推进，且能适应逐渐增强的水体杂散约束强度。深度调节能力提供了三维空间可达性，使机器人能够绕过杂物、从阻碍中恢复，并继续穿越原本不可通行的路径。在潜在的卡滞场景中，惯性诱发的滚动作为自发恢复机制，使机器人摆脱原本会导致失效的杂物，无需额外控制即可维持运动。该机器人在水下红树林环境中的测试表明，这些原理可迁移至实际作业，使其能够导航并对难以触及的根系区域进行机载视觉检测。这些成果确立了水体杂散环境运动原理，并构建了一种设计范式——使水下机器人将环境复杂性转化为运动资源。

title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
summary: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a bump trap, a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized.
tldr: This paper presents ERNEST, a planetary rover with active suspension, and uses reinforcement learning with domain randomization to train a single neural network controller that transfers zero-shot to the real robot, achieving robust all-terrain locomotion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ERNEST，一种具有主动悬挂系统的行星探测车，利用强化学习和域随机化训练单一神经网络控制器，零样本迁移到真实机器人，实现了鲁棒的越野运动。
summary_zh: 本论文提出ERNEST行星探测车概念，该探测车配备具有两个自由度的主动万向悬挂系统，通过横摆与滚转联合驱动实现车轮重构、转向及主动载荷重分配。采用单一神经网络控制器（经训练可在复杂地形中跟踪目标路径）充分解锁该主动悬挂系统在自主越障方面的潜力。基于高保真DARTS仿真引擎构建强化学习框架，该引擎融合刚体接触动力学与Bekker-Wong地面力学模型，使适应松软土壤的运动策略得以涌现。为获得跨异质地形的统一控制器，采用策略整合策略将地形特化智能体的经验融合至单一神经网络，消除了显式地形分类与控制器切换的需求。最终控制器融合本体感知与外感受反馈，包括立体视觉衍生稀疏地形高程、底盘姿态、关节状态及力-力矩测量值。通过域随机化、传感器噪声注入及模型-实物系统辨识实现向实体探测车的零样本迁移。实验结果表明，该控制器能自主穿越岩场、凸起陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹及沙质斜坡。在20°干沙斜坡上，尽管增加了主动驱动，学习控制器仍使运输能耗降低37%；而在被动悬挂完全失效的湿沙环境中，其性能表现更优。

title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.
tldr: AxisGuide renders robot base-frame axes as cue channels in RGB observations to bridge semantic understanding and action-coordinate interpretation, improving visuomotor manipulation policy generalization under distribution shifts.
tldr_zh: AxisGuide通过在RGB观测中渲染机器人基坐标系轴作为提示通道，弥合语义理解与动作坐标解释之间的差距，提升视觉动觉操作策略在分布偏移下的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 基于大规模行为克隆训练的视觉运动操控策略已具备强大的语义场景理解能力，但在分布偏移下往往无法可靠执行正确的底层动作。例如，即使是在场景布局、相机视角和光照条件完全相同的简单抓取任务中，当物体被放置在未见过的位置时，性能也会大幅下降。我们认为，这一差距源于对动作理解不足，即无法在图像空间中解读机器人基座坐标系。为解决该问题，我们提出AxisGuide——一种轻量级引导方法，能够桥接语义场景理解与动作坐标解释。通过利用相机参数和末端执行器位姿，AxisGuide在每个相机视角中渲染机器人基座坐标轴，并用少量提示通道增强RGB观测，显式展示图像空间中+x、+y和+z方向运动的含义。在LIBERO仿真环境及真实世界环境中的大量评估表明，AxisGuide能带来显著性能提升与泛化能力改进，凸显了显式动作坐标提示对于学习可靠且可迁移的通用视觉运动策略的有效性。

title: AEGIS: A Backup Reflex for Physical AI
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation tends to fail gradually: one bad step degrades the state, and the policy spirals into a basin from which it cannot recover. The failure is often visible before it happens. We introduce AEGIS (Activation-probe Early-warning, Gated Inference Switching), a selective escalation method that uses a lightweight probe on a weak policy's frozen activations to detect high-risk steps while there is still time to act. When the probe flags a step, control switches to a stronger separate policy, but only for the steps that need it. On LIBERO-Spatial, AEGIS recovers 10.1% of the trajectories the weak policy alone loses, versus 4.6% for budget-matched blind escalation and 5.1% for a random-trigger placebo. These gains are significant under one-sided exact paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment over three pre-registered contrasts: +5.4pp over blind escalation, p=8.5e-6; +5.0pp over random triggering, p=1.0e-4; paired-trajectory bootstrap CIs exclude zero. AEGIS activates the stronger policy on only 38% of steps, so the lever is timing rather than compute. The probe clears its precondition with an early-window AUROC of 0.764, 95% CI [0.70, 0.84], read from the weak-policy path over the first 30% of trajectory steps before any handoff. We pre-register the full analysis plan, including a conditional recovered-task-rate estimand and explicit kill criteria, and confirm the result on 700 common-random-number episodes per arm, with nA-fail=646.
tldr: AEGIS introduces a lightweight activation probe that detects imminent failures in robot manipulation and switches to a stronger policy only on high-risk steps, recovering more trajectories than blind or random escalation while using the stronger policy on only 38% of steps.
tldr_zh: AEGIS提出一种轻量级激活探针，在机器人操作中检测即将发生的失败，仅在高风险步骤切换到更强策略，仅在38%的步骤使用强策略即比盲目或随机升级恢复更多轨迹。
summary_zh: 长期机器人操作往往会逐步失效：一个错误步骤导致状态恶化，随之策略陷入无法恢复的困境。这种失败在发生前通常已显露出征兆。我们提出AEGIS（激活值探测预警与门控推理切换）方法，这是一种选择性升级策略，通过在弱策略的冻结激活值上部署轻量级探测模块，在仍有操作余地时识别高风险步骤。当探测模块标记某一步骤时，控制权将切换至更强的独立策略，但仅限于需要干预的步骤。在LIBERO-Spatial基准测试中，AEGIS能恢复弱策略单独运行时丢失轨迹的10.1%，而预算匹配的盲目升级策略恢复率为4.6%，随机触发安慰剂策略为5.1%。经Holm-Bonferroni校正的三组预先注册对比的单侧精确配对McNemar检验显示，这些提升具有显著性：相较盲目升级提升5.4个百分点（p=8.5e-6），相较随机触发提升5.0个百分点（p=1.0e-4）；配对轨迹自助法置信区间不包含零值。AEGIS仅在38%的步骤中激活更强策略，因此关键在于触发时机而非计算量。探测模块在弱策略路径前30%轨迹步骤（未发生任何切换前）读取的早期窗口AUROC值为0.764，95%置信区间[0.70, 0.84]，满足其前置条件。我们预注册了完整分析方案，包括条件性恢复任务率估计量和明确终止准则，并在每组700个公共随机数试验序列上验证结果（nA-fail=646）。

title: What Matters When Cotraining Robot Manipulation Policies on Everyday Human Videos?
summary: Human video datasets used for cotraining robot manipulation policies largely consist of curated demonstrations where motions are orchestrated to resemble robot behavior and 3D hand poses are captured with specialized hardware. A more plentiful source of data is everyday Internet video, but it is an open question what factors enable transfer from such videos to robots. We investigate this using a new dataset of 532 human videos with 28 hours of high-quality triangulated hand labels and natural motions. We find that hand pose quality affects transfer, but even with accurate hands, the inherent motion gap hinders transfer unless the vision and policy networks specialize to each embodiment. Our cotraining recipe yields consistent improvements, with an absolute success rate gain of $29.7\%$ in the low-robot-data regime across six manipulation tasks.
tldr: This paper investigates how everyday human videos can be used to cotrain robot manipulation policies, finding that accurate hand pose labels and embodiment-specific specialization are key, achieving a 29.7% absolute success rate gain in the low-robot-data regime.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了如何利用日常人类视频来共同训练机器人操作策略，发现准确的手部姿态标签和针对不同具身形态的特化是关键，在低机器人数据场景下实现了29.7%的绝对成功率提升。
summary_zh: 用于联合训练机器人操控策略的人类视频数据集，主要包含经过精心筛选的示范视频，其中动作被编排得与机器人行为相似，且3D手部姿态需通过专用硬件捕捉。更丰富的数据来源是日常互联网视频，但哪些因素能够促进此类视频向机器人的迁移仍是一个开放问题。我们通过一个包含532段人类视频（共计28小时高质量三角测量手部标注与自然动作）的新数据集对此展开研究。研究发现手部姿态质量会影响迁移效果，但即便拥有精确的手部数据，固有的运动差异仍会阻碍迁移——除非视觉与策略网络针对每种具体形态进行专项适配。我们的联合训练方案在六项操控任务的低机器人数据场景中实现了稳定的性能提升，绝对成功率提升了29.7%。

title: Re-imagining ISO 26262 in the Age of Autonomous Vehicles: Enhancing Controllability through Transferability and Predictability
summary: The ISO 26262 standard defines functional safety for road vehicles through risk assessments based on Severity, Exposure, and Controllability, grounded in a human-driven vehicle paradigm. In the context of autonomous vehicles (AVs), the absence of a human driver necessitates revisiting these principles. This paper decomposes the Controllability placeholder into two auditable evidence dimensions of ISO 26262 by introducing two measurable sub-concepts: Transferability and Predictability. Transferability extends Controllability to capture AV systems' ability to hand off control to dedicated fallback safety mechanisms, while Predictability captures how easily external agents can anticipate AV behavior. Predictability is formally defined from human-robot interaction-inspired principles, and a mathematical framework is provided to quantify it. A designed-versus-achievable gap is introduced to distinguish architectural fallback claims from scene-conditioned achievable fallback capability. The proposed metrics align with ISO 26262 and ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF), rendering fallback and interaction claims falsifiable and traceable across ODD slices. These dimensions complement rather than replace existing standards, and the enhancements preserve the structure of ISO 26262 while extending its applicability to driverless automated systems operating at SAE Levels 4 and 5.
tldr: This paper extends ISO 26262 for autonomous vehicles by replacing Controllability with measurable sub-concepts Transferability and Predictability, providing a mathematical framework to quantify AV controllability and align with safety standards.
tldr_zh: 本文为自动驾驶车辆扩展ISO 26262标准，用可量化的可转移性和可预测性替代可控性概念，并提供了数学框架，与安全标准对齐。
summary_zh: ISO 26262标准基于以人类驾驶为核心的范式，通过严重性、暴露性和可控性风险评估，定义了道路车辆的功能安全。在自动驾驶车辆（AV）背景下，由于缺乏人类驾驶员，需重新审视这些原则。本文通过引入两个可度量的子概念——可转移性与可预测性，将可控性占位符分解为ISO 26262的两个可审计证据维度。可转移性扩展了可控性，用于表征自动驾驶系统将控制权移交给专用降级安全机制的能力；可预测性则反映外部主体预测自动驾驶行为的能力。基于人-机器人交互启发原则正式定义了可预测性，并提供了量化其值的数学框架。引入"设计能力与可实现能力"差异概念，以区分基于架构的降级声明与场景条件约束下的可实现降级能力。所提指标与ISO 26262及ISO/PAS 21448（SOTIF）标准保持一致，使降级与交互声明在运行设计域（ODD）切片上具备可证伪性与可追溯性。这些维度是对现有标准的补充而非替代，改进措施在保留ISO 26262架构的同时，将其适用性扩展至SAE L4和L5级别的无人自动化系统。

title: Rapid co-design of Buoyancy-assisted robots for Challenging Locomotion using Gaussian Evolutionary Specialists
summary: Designing high-performance legged robots requires jointly optimizing morphology and control. Model-free Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers an alternative to model-predictive control for developing robust controllers without explicitly specifying robot dynamics. Thus, we have seen theuse of RL to train controllers and evaluate designs for robot morphology optimization. While RL has shown success inlocomotion, using it in the co-design inner loop is expensive due to repeated policy training. Universal policies conditioned on morphology offer a promising alternative, but suffer from behavioral diversity collapse, converging to a single strategy that performs sub-optimally across designs. On the other hand, end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures fail due to a collapse in its representation. We propose Gaussian Evolutionary Specialists (GES), a framework that decouples design-space partitioning from policy learning to capture diverse behaviors explicitly. GES assigns specialist policies to evolving Gaussian regions and iteratively refines them via training, probing, and territory expansion. The resulting specialists are integrated into a design sampling loop, replacing costly re-training with direct evaluation. When tested on the Buoyancy-Assisted Light Legged Unit (BALLU), GES discovers designs with 5 - 25% higher performance than naive universal policies. On hardware, a GES optimized design overcomes a 24 cm tall obstacle - 3x improvement over the baseline BALLU design. Moreover, GES curtails design optimization time by 37%.
tldr: Proposes Gaussian Evolutionary Specialists (GES) for co-designing morphology and control of buoyancy-assisted legged robots, achieving better performance than universal policies and reducing design optimization time by 37%.
tldr_zh: 提出高斯进化专家（GES）用于浮力辅助腿式机器人的形态与控制协同设计，性能优于通用策略，并将设计优化时间减少37%。
summary_zh: 设计高性能足式机器人需要联合优化形态与控制。无模型强化学习为开发鲁棒控制器提供了一种替代模型预测控制的方法，无需显式指定机器人动力学模型。因此，我们已看到强化学习被用于训练控制器并评估用于机器人形态优化的设计方案。尽管强化学习在运动控制方面取得了成功，但由于需要重复策略训练，将其用于协同设计的内循环代价高昂。基于形态条件的通用策略提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但存在行为多样性崩溃的问题——会收敛到一种在所有设计中表现次优的单一策略。另一方面，端到端混合专家架构因其表征坍塌而失效。我们提出高斯演化专家框架，该框架将设计空间划分与策略学习解耦，以显式捕获多样化行为。高斯演化专家为演化中的高斯区域分配专家策略，并通过训练、探测和区域扩展迭代优化这些策略。最终生成的专家策略被集成到设计采样循环中，用直接评估替代昂贵的重新训练。在浮力辅助轻量足式单元上的测试表明，相较于朴素通用策略，高斯演化专家发现的设计性能提升5%-25%。在硬件实验中，该优化设计可跨越24厘米高的障碍物——相较于基线BALLU设计提升3倍。此外，高斯演化专家将设计优化时间缩减37%。

title: Simulation-Driven Imitation Learning for Biosignals-Free Shared-Autonomy Prosthetic Grasping
summary: Biosignals-free shared-autonomy control of upper-limb prosthetic hands aims to enable natural and low-effort manipulation without relying on EMG or other physiological signals. Recent imitation-learning-based approaches have shown promising results, but their scalability is limited by the cost and variability of collecting large amounts of real-world human demonstration data. In this work, we present a scalable simulation framework that automatically generates diverse reach-to-grasp demonstrations from a wrist-mounted virtual camera. The framework combines physically feasible grasp synthesis, natural reaching trajectories retargeting, and reach--grasp--lift execution in procedurally generated indoor environments. It records wrist-view observations, proprioception, and actions to build a large-scale demonstration dataset for imitation learning. Through extensive simulation benchmarks, we evaluate object and scene generalization and compare several representative state-of-the-art imitation learning methods. Results show that the simulated demonstrations are sufficiently rich and consistent for effective policy learning. In three realistic settings, the learned sim-to-real policy achieves over 90\% grasp success, surpasses baseline methods, and exhibits stronger generalization, highlighting the promise of simulation-driven training for biosignals-free shared-autonomy prosthetic grasping. The demonstrations are available at \href{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}.
tldr: This paper proposes a simulation-driven imitation learning framework for biosignals-free shared-autonomy prosthetic grasping, automatically generating diverse reach-to-grasp demonstrations from wrist-mounted cameras. The sim-to-real policy achieves over 90% grasp success in realistic settings, demonstrating strong generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模拟驱动的模仿学习框架，用于无生物信号共享自主假手抓取，通过腕部摄像头自动生成多样化的抓取演示。模拟到真实的策略在现实场景中实现了超过90%的抓取成功率，并展现出强大的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 无生物信号共享自主控制的上肢假手旨在不依赖肌电信号或其他生理信号的情况下，实现自然且低负担的操作。近期基于模仿学习的方法虽展现出良好前景，但其可扩展性受限于大规模真实世界人类示教数据采集的高成本与差异性。本研究提出一个可扩展的仿真框架，该框架通过腕部安装的虚拟摄像头自动生成多样化的抓取-接近动作示教。该框架结合物理可行的抓取合成、自然接近轨迹重定向，以及在程序化生成室内环境中的接近-抓取-举起执行流程。通过记录腕部视角观测数据、本体感觉及动作信息，构建用于模仿学习的大规模示教数据集。我们通过大量仿真基准测试评估目标与场景泛化能力，并对比多种代表性先进模仿学习方法。结果表明，仿真示教数据具备充分丰富性与一致性，可支持有效的策略学习。在三个现实场景中，学得的仿真到现实策略实现了超过90%的抓取成功率，超越基线方法并展现出更强的泛化能力，凸显了基于仿真训练驱动无生物信号共享自主假肢抓取的潜力。示教数据可通过\href{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}获取。

title: Beyond Waypoints: A Trajectory-Centric Waypointing Paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions while navigating in real-world-like environments. Most VLN-CE approach\-es adopt a three-stage framework: a waypoint predictor proposes navigable waypoints, and a navigator selects the best waypoint, with a low-level controller executing the movement to it. However, this decoupled paradigm often leads to unreachable waypoints or inconsistencies between planning and control. In this work, instead of predicting isolated waypoints, we introduce a novel paradigm called Trajectory Waypoint, which grounds each candidate waypoint in an executable trajectory. To realize this, we design a Trajectory Waypoint Predictor formulated as a TSDF-guided diffusion policy, which steers trajectory generation away from obstacles, inherently ensuring the reachability of the predicted waypoints. We further propose a trajectory-enhanced navigator that injects the associated trajectory as additional information for planning, enabling strict consistency between high-level semantic decisions and low-level execution. Extensive experiments on the VLN-CE benchmark show that our Trajectory Waypoint paradigm achieves superior performance over the baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces a trajectory-centric waypointing paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments, using a TSDF-guided diffusion policy to generate executable trajectories instead of isolated waypoints, improving reachability and consistency between planning and control.
tldr_zh: 本文针对连续环境下的视觉语言导航，提出了一种以轨迹为中心的路径点范式，利用TSDF引导的扩散策略生成可执行的轨迹而非孤立的路径点，提升了可达性以及规划与控制的一致性。
summary_zh: 连续环境下的视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在类真实环境中遵循自然语言指令进行导航。现有大多数VLN-CE方法采用三阶段框架：路径点预测器生成可导航路径点，导航器选择最优路径点，并通过底层控制器执行移动动作。然而，这种解耦范式常导致路径点不可达或规划与控制间的不一致。本研究提出一种名为“轨迹路径点”的新型范式，该范式不再预测孤立路径点，而是将每个候选路径点锚定至可执行轨迹上。为实现该范式，我们设计了基于TSDF引导扩散策略的轨迹路径点预测器，该预测器可引导轨迹生成避开障碍物，从本质上确保预测路径点的可达性。我们进一步提出轨迹增强型导航器，将关联轨迹作为额外规划信息注入，实现高层语义决策与底层执行之间的严格一致性。在VLN-CE基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的轨迹路径点范式相较于基线方法取得了更优性能。

title: Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.
tldr: This paper presents a predictive safety filter that post-hoc modifies contact locations for legged locomotion policies, ensuring collision avoidance in cluttered environments via sampling-based optimization with a full-physics model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种预测性安全过滤器，通过事后修正腿式运动策略的接触位置，利用基于采样的优化和全物理模型在杂乱环境中避免碰撞。
summary_zh: 强化学习策略能够实现动态腿部运动，但缺乏机制来避免训练中未出现的违反安全约束的情况。大规模离线安全学习对于覆盖所有边界情况并不现实。现有安全框架要么依赖无法推理全身行为的降阶模型，要么需要采用降低任务性能的保守恢复控制器。我们提出一种预测式安全过滤器，其对输入强化学习策略的标称接触位置进行事后过滤。当预测到碰撞时，基于采样的优化器利用全物理模型异步搜索更安全的接触序列，同时学习的价值函数对长时域回报进行自举。我们的三个算法组件（采样接触点的几何投影、动量增强更新以及副本交换）使得在不连续的接触景观中进行优化变得可行。我们在密集杂乱环境中的四足机器人上（包括仿真和真实场景）验证了该过滤器，结果表明在最小偏离标称输入的情况下，安全违规事件显著减少。

title: Task Editing for Generalizable 3D Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: 3D visuomotor policies offer a promising direction for complex robotic manipulation, as depth maps and point clouds provide rich geometric information for spatial reasoning. However, their success often depends on large-scale real-world demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect. To this end, existing methods commonly use demonstration generation strategies to improve data efficiency by applying object-centric transformations to human-collected demonstrations, such as varying object poses or scales. While effective for local variation, these transformations largely preserve the original scene structure and skill sequence, limiting their ability to synthesize diverse scene-skill-object combinations for complex tasks. In this paper, we propose Task-Edit, a novel demonstration generation framework that generates diverse trajectories from a task-centric editing perspective. The key insight of Task-Edit is to decompose a task into scene, skill and object components, and flexibly recombine them. In this way, Task-Edit enables scalable demonstration generation and significantly improves generalization for long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate Task-Edit through extensive real-world experiments and demonstrate three advantages: (1) Effectiveness: Task-Edit significantly improves 3D visuomotor policies across various real-world tasks and robot embodiments. (2) Generalizability: Task-Edit improves model generalization across different scenario setups. (3) Applicability: Task-Edit enables models to handle scenarios that are difficult to collect in the real world, including disturbance resistance, obstacle avoidance and unseen cluttered scenes.
tldr: Task-Edit generates diverse robot demonstration trajectories by decomposing tasks into scene, skill, and object components and recombining them, improving generalization of 3D visuomotor policies.
tldr_zh: Task-Edit 通过将任务分解为场景、技能和物体组件并重新组合，生成多样化的机器人演示轨迹，提升了3D视觉运动策略的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 3D视觉运动策略为复杂机器人操作提供了有前景的研究方向，因为深度图与点云能为空间推理提供丰富的几何信息。然而，这类策略的有效性往往依赖于大规模真实世界演示数据的采集，这既昂贵又耗时。为此，现有方法通常采用基于物体中心的变换策略（如调整物体姿态或尺寸）对人类采集的演示数据进行增强，以提升数据效率。虽然这类变换能产生局部数据变化，但本质上仍保留了原始场景结构与技能序列，难以针对复杂任务合成多样化的场景-技能-物体组合。本文提出Task-Edit——一种全新的演示生成框架，其核心理念是从任务导向的编辑视角生成多样化轨迹：将任务解构为场景、技能和物体三个组件并灵活重组。通过这种方式，Task-Edit实现了可扩展的演示生成，显著提升了长时域操作任务的泛化能力。我们通过大量真实世界实验验证了Task-Edit的三项优势：(1) 有效性：该框架能显著提升多种真实任务和机器人形态下的3D视觉运动策略性能；(2) 泛化性：增强模型在不同场景配置下的泛化能力；(3) 适用性：使模型能够处理现实环境中难以采集的复杂场景，包括抗干扰、避障及未知杂乱场景。

title: A Cross-view Fusion Framework for Robust 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation
summary: In this paper, we propose a cross-view fusion framework that enhances the robustness of 6-DoF grasp pose estimation in corner views. Our framework alleviates occlusion by incorporating an auxiliary view and avoids the time-consuming, task-agnostic multi-view reconstruction through a post-fusion strategy. To enhance cross-view fusion, we propose a self-supervised contrastive learning strategy that leverages cross-view associations to regularize point cloud features. In brief, a cross-view point pair is considered a match if the two points correspond to the same 3D location, and a non-match if they represent distinct grasp directions. The learning strategy significantly enhances the spatial consistency and direction distinctiveness of point features, thereby facilitating cross-view fusion and improving estimation robustness. Furthermore, we propose a cross-view-aligned cylinder integration module to fuse grasp-relevant geometry into a comprehensive representation. Specifically, the module first aligns the cross-view points and features according to their similarity to enhance the robustness against noise. Subsequently, these points are registered into the cylindrical coordinate frame, emphasizing the rotation-symmetric geometry which is important for grasping. Finally, local self-attention and seed cross-attention layers are alternately employed, respectively enabling interactions within single views and across views, which supports fine-grained representation of grasp-relevant geometry. Our framework achieves strong performance on the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark and in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/KJZhuAutomatic/Cross-view-Grasp.
tldr: This paper proposes a cross-view fusion framework with contrastive learning and a cylinder integration module to improve 6-DoF grasp pose estimation under occlusion, evaluated on GraspNet-1Billion and real-world applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种跨视图融合框架，结合对比学习和圆柱积分模块，提升遮挡下的六自由度抓取姿态估计鲁棒性，在GraspNet-1Billion基准和真实场景中取得良好效果。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种跨视角融合框架，用于增强角落视角下六自由度抓取位姿估计的鲁棒性。该框架通过引入辅助视角缓解遮挡问题，并采用后融合策略避免了耗时且与任务无关的多视角重建。为提升跨视角融合效果，我们提出了一种自监督对比学习策略，利用跨视角关联对点云特征进行正则化。简言之，若跨视角点对对应同一三维空间位置则视为匹配，若代表不同抓取方向则视为非匹配。该学习策略显著增强了点特征的空间一致性与方向区分性，从而促进跨视角融合并提升估计鲁棒性。此外，我们提出跨视角对齐的圆柱体集成模块，将抓取相关几何信息融合为综合表征。具体而言，该模块首先根据相似性对齐跨视角点与特征以增强对噪声的鲁棒性，随后将这些点注册至圆柱坐标系中，突出对抓取至关重要的旋转对称几何结构。最后，交替使用局部自注意力层与种子交叉注意力层，分别实现单视角内与跨视角间的交互，从而支持抓取相关几何信息的细粒度表征。本框架在GraspNet-1Billion基准测试及实际应用中均取得了优异性能。代码开源地址：https://github.com/KJZhuAutomatic/Cross-view-Grasp。

title: Lane Change Trajectory Planning for Personalized Driving Comfort and Mobility Efficiency
summary: Lane changing entails simultaneous longitudinal and lateral motions that affect driving comfort and mobility efficiency. Because these motions are tightly coupled and subject to substantial inter-vehicle variability, trajectory planning for lane-change maneuvers is characterized by a highly personalized nature. This study proposes a neural network-driven planner that integrates a third-order polynomial trajectory generator with a learning module that infers optimal trajectory parameters across diverse driving conditions. Using a shared backbone with dual heads, one head ensures all-condition operational guarantees, while the other captures driver-specific preferences for comfort or mobility efficiency. A head-gated switching mechanism, realized through a statistical gate based on error-winner logistic regression, adaptively selects the appropriate head under varying driving conditions, which enables context-aware lane-change trajectory planning. Representative cases and Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed planner achieves personalized comfort and mobility during lane changes, while the baseline ensures feasible trajectories under driving conditions where personalized data are insufficient or inaccessible.
tldr: This paper proposes a neural network-driven lane change trajectory planner that combines a polynomial trajectory generator with a dual-head architecture and a gating mechanism to balance personalized comfort and mobility efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经网络驱动的换道轨迹规划器，结合多项式轨迹生成器、双头架构和门控机制，以平衡个性化舒适度与交通效率。
summary_zh: 变道涉及同时进行的纵向与横向运动，这些运动会影响驾驶舒适性和机动效率。由于这两种运动紧密耦合且存在显著的车际差异，变道轨迹规划具有高度个性化的特点。本研究提出一种神经网络驱动的规划器，该规划器将三阶多项式轨迹生成器与学习模块相结合，通过该学习模块可推断不同驾驶条件下的最优轨迹参数。利用共享主干网络搭配双预测头：一个预测头确保全工况运行保障，另一个则捕捉驾驶员对舒适性或机动效率的个性化偏好。基于误差胜出逻辑回归的统计门控机制实现预测头切换，能够在不同驾驶条件下自适应选择合适预测头，从而完成情境感知的变道轨迹规划。典型案例分析与蒙特卡洛仿真表明：所提出的规划器在变道过程中实现了个性化舒适性与机动性，而基准方案可在个性化数据不足或无法获取的驾驶条件下保证轨迹可行性。

title: SCOUT: Semantic scene COverage via Uncertainty-guided Traversal
summary: Robots that operate over extended periods should not merely visit space; they should progressively understand it. Yet most 3D scene graph pipelines treat perception as a post-processing stage over a fixed dataset, decoupling scene representation from the decisions that determine what is observed in the first place. We present SCOUT, an online semantic exploration framework that closes this loop by coupling active traversal with probabilistic scene graph construction. Given a prior 2D occupancy map and posed RGB-D observations, SCOUT incrementally builds an uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph whose nodes maintain fused geometry and posterior beliefs over open-vocabulary object labels, while edges encode structural relations such as on, inside, belong, and next to. These beliefs are fed back to an uncertainty-guided traversal planner, which selects viewpoints by balancing expected semantic certainty gain, geometric coverage gain, and travel cost. In this way, the robot revisits ambiguous objects when additional evidence matters and expands into unseen free space when the scene remains incomplete. The resulting system treats semantic scene completeness as an operational objective rather than a passive by-product of semantic mapping, moving toward autonomous agents that can patrol, update, and reason about evolving indoor environments with minimal human intervention.
tldr: SCOUT couples active robot traversal with online uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph construction, using an uncertainty-guided planner that balances semantic certainty gain, geometric coverage, and travel cost to achieve semantic scene completeness.
tldr_zh: SCOUT 将主动遍历与在线不确定性感知的3D场景图构建相结合，通过平衡语义确定性增益、几何覆盖和移动成本的不确定性引导规划器，实现语义场景的完整性。
summary_zh: 长期运行的机器人不应仅仅是访问空间，而应逐步理解空间。然而，大多数3D场景图管线将感知视为固定数据集上的后处理阶段，将场景表示与最初决定观察内容的决策分离开来。我们提出了SCOPT——一种在线语义探索框架，通过将主动遍历与概率场景图构建相结合来闭环这一过程。给定先验的2D占用地图和带位姿的RGB-D观测，SCOPT逐步构建一个具有不确定性感知的3D场景图，其节点维护融合几何信息及对开放词汇对象标签的后验置信度，而边则编码诸如“在……上”、“在……内部”、“属于”和“邻接”等结构关系。这些置信度被反馈给一个不确定性引导的遍历规划器，该规划器通过平衡预期语义确定性增益、几何覆盖增益和移动代价来选择视点。通过这种方式，当额外信息有助于判定时，机器人会重新审视模糊对象；当场景尚不完整时，则会探索未见的自由空间。由此产生的系统将语义场景完整性视为操作目标，而非语义映射的被动副产品，推动自主智能体能够在极少人工干预下巡逻、更新和推理动态演化的室内环境。

title: Optimal Control Approach for Non-prehensile Ball Juggling Using a 7-DoF Manipulator
summary: Non-prehensile object manipulation skills are important for real-world robot interactions, enabling highly dynamic tasks such as balancing a glass on a tray or the controlled sliding of items on a table. Among such tasks, those characterised by high-speed manipulation requirements and general sensitivity of the resulting hybrid dynamics are particularly hard to accomplish. Within these, juggling can be seen as a highly challenging maneuver to be solved. The key to robotic juggling is achieving dynamic stabilisation of an underactuated object. Since the object does not possess the ability of self-correction, its stability is entirely dependent on the forces applied to it. This creates a system that is sensitive to control inputs, where timing is critical to continuously counteract deviations and maintain the desired behavior. We develop a systematic method to control a 7-degree-of-freedom manipulator performing non-prehensile ball juggling with a tool. Our primary contribution is a model-based framework for generating juggling trajectories and stabilizing a periodic juggling motion for this hybrid system. The framework incorporates a two-stage optimal control approach to compute the underlying feasible motion patterns required for stable juggling. Offline-computed trajectories are then organised to enable real-time error correction without solving optimal control problems online. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting controller by first evaluating its performance in a simulation environment and performing an experiment using a Franka Emika Panda robot.
